segments.text:
How honourable are Christians by their new birth! they are born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of
man, but of God, Joh. 1. 13. (i. e.) not in an impure, or meer natural way, but in a most spiritual and supernatural manner: they are the off-spring of God, the children of the most high, as well by regeneration as by adoption: which is the greatest advancement of the humane nature next to its hypostatical union with the second person: Oh what honour is this for a poor sinful creature to have the very life of God breathed into his soul! all other dignities of nature are trifles compar'd with this: this makes a Christian a sacred hallowed thing, the living temple of God, 1 Cor. 6. 19. the special object of his delight.
